vehicle.name: Nissan Skyline GT-R R32 / BNR32
vehicle.coverage: ECU pin functions from Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS EN-171/EN-172 (PLMS reprint). Map positions use factory or dual-source locations where available; remaining items stay estimated.

nodes.name: ECCS engine control unit (ECU)
nodes.location: Behind the passenger (left) kick panel, in the front footwell.
nodes.notes: Nissan ECCS ECU with 76 pins (pins 1-60 and 101-116). The R32 has no immobiliser.
nodes.loc_src: Haltech Nexus plug-in install (passenger kick panel) · GTR UK ECU location thread · GTR USA ECCS wiring

nodes.name: ECCS relay
nodes.location: Engine-bay relay box (with the fusible links), not at the ECU.
nodes.notes: ECU pin 16 drives the coil. Pins 49 and 59 are the ECU power feed from this relay. Pin 109 is injector power, not this relay.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS circuit (EN-171) · GTR USA factory fuse/relay label chart

nodes.name: Fuel pump relay
nodes.location: In the boot, near the boot lock (green relay on GT-R).
nodes.loc_src: GTR UK R32 GT-R fuel pump relay location · SAU R32 boot relay reports

nodes.name: Fuel pump control module (FPCM)
nodes.location: Behind the right (driver) rear quarter trim, beside the rear seat.
nodes.notes: ECU pins 104 and 106 command high/low pump speed. Nissan 17001-05U01.
nodes.loc_src: GTR USA FPCM article · Minkara R32 FPCM location

nodes.name: Fuel pump
nodes.location: In the fuel tank under the boot floor (in-tank pump).
nodes.notes: Driven by the FPCM. Access panel is in the boot, not a cabin rear-seat hatch.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM fuel system · GTR USA fuel pump inspection sheet

nodes.name: Power transistor unit (ignition)
nodes.location: Engine bay, intake side of the RB26, driving the six coil-on-plug units.
nodes.notes: ECU pins 1, 2, 3, 11, 12, 13 are the six ignition signals (cyl 1, 5, 3, 6, 2, 4).
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS system figure EN-169 to EN-171

nodes.name: ATTESA E-TS 4WD control unit
nodes.location: In the boot, under the parcel shelf (left side).
nodes.notes: LED on the unit shows fault codes. ECU pin 56 is the engine-speed/torque signal to ATTESA.
nodes.loc_src: UP Garage ATTESA codes · GTR USA ATTESA ECU location

nodes.name: HICAS control unit (rear steer)
nodes.location: Under the rear parcel shelf.
nodes.notes: Self-diagnosis uses the HICAS warning light.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ST/HICAS control unit location · R32 GT-R workshop rear-steer section

nodes.name: Combination meter
nodes.location: Instrument panel, in front of the driver (RHD right).
nodes.notes: Tachometer from ECU pin 7; check-engine/monitor lamp from pin 32.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM combination meter · ECCS EN-171 pin 7/32

nodes.name: CONSULT diagnosis connector
nodes.location: Under the dashboard, driver (right) side. 14-pin CONSULT, not OBD-II.
nodes.notes: ECU pins 21 RX, 22 TX, 31 CLK, 47 CHK.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS diagnosis connector · EN-171 terminal symbols

nodes.name: Ignition switch
nodes.location: On the steering column, driver side.
nodes.notes: START to ECU pin 43; IGN to pin 45.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM starting system · ECCS EN-171

nodes.name: Air flow meter, front
nodes.location: In the front-bank intake pipe after the front air cleaner, engine bay.
nodes.notes: Quantity signal ECU pin 35; AFM ground pin 34.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS system figure (dual AFM) EN-16/EN-171

nodes.name: Air flow meter, rear
nodes.location: In the rear-bank intake pipe after the rear air cleaner, engine bay.
nodes.notes: Quantity signal ECU pin 27; AFM ground pin 26.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS system figure (dual AFM) EN-16/EN-171

nodes.name: Crank angle sensor (CAS)
nodes.location: Front of the cylinder head, on the exhaust camshaft.
nodes.notes: 1° and 120° signals. Not a crankshaft sensor.
nodes.loc_src: PLMS R32 GTR ECCS · GTR USA ECCS wiring

nodes.name: Throttle sensor
nodes.location: On the throttle body (intake side of the plenum).
nodes.notes: Signal ECU pin 38; 5 V from pin 48; sensor ground pin 30.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS throttle sensor · EN-171

nodes.name: Throttle valve switch (idle)
nodes.location: On the throttle body, integral with the throttle sensor assembly.
nodes.notes: Idle contact ECU pin 54; switch power pin 57.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS throttle valve switch · EN-171

nodes.name: Engine coolant temperature sensor
nodes.location: Front of the engine, coolant outlet / thermostat housing.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM engine temperature sensor location · ECCS EN-171

nodes.name: Intake air temperature sensor
nodes.location: In the intake tract (factory IAT; GT-R may use the AFM-integrated sensor).
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS · Haltech R32 IAT note

nodes.name: Exhaust gas (O2) sensor, front
nodes.location: Front turbocharger outlet / front exhaust manifold collector.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS system figure EN-16

nodes.name: Exhaust gas (O2) sensor, rear
nodes.location: Rear turbocharger outlet / rear exhaust manifold collector.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS system figure EN-16

nodes.name: Knock sensor, cylinders 1-3
nodes.location: Left side of the cylinder block, under the intake manifold, front (cyl 1-3).
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS detonation sensor · EN-171

nodes.name: Knock sensor, cylinders 4-6
nodes.location: Left side of the cylinder block, under the intake manifold, rear (cyl 4-6).
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS detonation sensor · EN-171

nodes.name: Vehicle speed sensor
nodes.location: On the transmission / transfer case.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS vehicle speed sensor · EN-171

nodes.name: Neutral position switch
nodes.location: On the transmission (neutral switch).
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS · starting system

nodes.name: Power steering oil pressure switch
nodes.location: On the power-steering high-pressure line / pump, engine bay.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS power steering oil pressure switch · EN-171

nodes.name: Air conditioner switch
nodes.location: Heater / A/C control panel in the dashboard.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS air conditioner switch · EN-171

nodes.name: Injector No. 1
nodes.location: Intake side of cylinder 1 (front of engine).
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS injector layout · EN-172

nodes.name: Injector No. 2
nodes.location: Intake side of cylinder 2.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS injector layout · EN-172

nodes.name: Injector No. 3
nodes.location: Intake side of cylinder 3.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS injector layout · EN-172

nodes.name: Injector No. 4
nodes.location: Intake side of cylinder 4.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS injector layout · EN-172

nodes.name: Injector No. 5
nodes.location: Intake side of cylinder 5.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS injector layout · EN-172

nodes.name: Injector No. 6
nodes.location: Intake side of cylinder 6 (firewall end).
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS injector layout · EN-172

nodes.name: Ignition coils (6, one on each plug)
nodes.location: Coil-on-plug on the cylinder head, one per cylinder.
nodes.notes: Driven by the power transistor unit, not directly by the ECU.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS ignition · EN-169

nodes.name: AAC valve (idle air control)
nodes.location: On the intake collector / AAC idle air path.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS AAC valve · EN-171

nodes.name: Wastegate valve control solenoid (boost)
nodes.location: Engine bay, boost-control solenoid on the wastegate pressure line.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS wastegate solenoid · EN-171

nodes.name: Sub electric fan relay
nodes.location: Engine-bay relay box.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS sub electric fan relay · factory relay-box label

nodes.name: Air conditioner relay
nodes.location: Engine-bay relay box (AIR CON on the lid chart).
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM ECCS · GTR USA factory fuse/relay label chart

nodes.name: Battery
nodes.location: Engine bay, passenger (left) side next to the relay box.
nodes.notes: Which side is the factory left-hand (passenger on RHD) tray.
nodes.loc_src: GTR USA replacement battery · ImportaVehicle battery fitment · FSM charging system

nodes.name: Fuse block (passenger compartment, fuses 1-26)
nodes.location: Passenger-compartment fuse block, under the dash on the driver (right) side.
nodes.notes: Fuse 7 engine control 10 A; fuse 8 fuel pump 15 A.
nodes.loc_src: GTR USA R32 factory fuse label chart (passenger box)

nodes.name: Engine relay box (fusible links I-VII, fuses 31-33)
nodes.location: Engine bay, passenger (left) side, beside the battery.
nodes.notes: Fusible link I MAIN 75 A; link VI ENG CONT 25 A to ECCS relay.
nodes.loc_src: GTR USA R32 factory fuse label chart (engine relay box)

nodes.name: ECU ground point
nodes.location: ECU pins 50 and 60 are control-unit grounds. Body-bolt location is not on the indexed FSM pages.
nodes.notes: Do not treat the map marker as a specific chassis bolt.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM EN-171 (function only; bolt not shown)

nodes.name: Ignition system ground
nodes.location: ECU pins 10 and 20, ignition-signal ground. Engine-bolt location not indexed.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM EN-171 (function only)

nodes.name: Injector ground
nodes.location: ECU pins 107, 108 and 116. Engine-bolt location not indexed.
nodes.loc_src: Nissan BNR32 FSM EN-172 (function only)
